Even if it is safer than most planetside dwellings the Sector has to offer, its appearance ensures only the brave or the desparate would make their homes here.

A series of ambitious modifications have been made to this Venture in some dark shipyard on the outer rim. The hangar space and ore bays have been replaced by a hardpoint capable of mounting an enormous missile launcher, munitions storage, and a largely reliable generic autoloader system. The fact that this missile launcher is rear-facing has inspired a great number of colorful nicknames for this hull variant by crew and foe alike.
Fanatics of the Luddic Path have made this ship their own, stripping out all unnecessary furnishing and transforming it into a haphazard vehicle of holy war.
This ship has been heavily modified - and poorly maintained - by its pirate crew.

This ship has been given Hegemony markings. Systems modifications are otherwise superficial.

This ship has undergone cutting-edged alterations by the Research Mandate. Utilising advanced (and some might say, A.I. influenced) engineering, this vessel is able to produce localised regions of phased space in their hulls, mitigating some incoming damage.

While a typical 'Atlas Mk.II' is impressive enough in its armament, this example of the class stands above and beyond in the quality of its refit. Beyond the obvious improvements to the usually-slapshod armor plating, it boasts a fully integrated targeting computer and missile guidance systems outclassing even those of most purpose-built warships. However, despite the bright 'Fourteenth Battlegroup' livery - and the bold 'NOT PIRATE' emblazoned on the deck in capital letters tens of meters tall - there is not even the slightest possibility this superfreighter-cum-warship is a vessel of the Domain nor any of its claimed successors. No, the hulk before you is a monument to pirate ingenuity, a testament to the infinite creativity of mankind when it comes to finding new and interesting ways to kill each other.
This ship has been modified far beyond its original capabilities by the Aleph Ascendancy, transforming it from a powerful but relatively standard frigate into a deadly automated hunter-killer.

This ship has been refit by the fringe Luddic tech-heretic cult known as the Ashen Keepers. Along with a flashy paintjob, it has received extensive defensive upgrades designed to benefit them in their eternal crusade against the more mainstream Luddic sects of the Path and Church of Galactic Redemption. Unfortunately, these refits - performed with readily available equipment by enthusiastic but undertrained enginseers - require frequent maintenance and have significantly increased the running costs of the vessel.
This ship has been heavily modified over the cycles by its elite naval deserter crew, gaining capabilities far beyond those of a normal Eagle-class cruiser - with a reputation to match.
These fighters have been painted in Stormhawk Republic livery.
This ship has been given Luddic Church markings. Systems modifications are otherwise superficial.
Fanatics of the Luddic Path have made this ship their own, stripping out all unnecessary furnishing and transforming it into a haphazard vehicle of holy war.

This Buffalo Mk.II has been produced on a standardized assembly line by the Luddic Church, resulting in a converted freighter much closer to the lines of an actual warship than is typical for its class of vessel.

This Buffalo Mk.II has been expertly rebuilt to standards much closer to those of an actual warship than is the norm for these vessels. Beneath the bright coat of Red Guards livery, it has been stripped down and rebuilt for maximum durability at minimal cost. Elaborate sensor arrays and failure-prone high-tech communication consoles have been pared away, leaving only those systems absolutely necessary to the vessel's function as a mercilessly efficient weapon of war.

For unknown reasons, this Buffalo Mk. II has been painted in a clumsy approximation of Fourteenth Battlegroup colors and the ident chip hacked to read 'Buffalo Mk. XIV'. Perhaps an ill-considered bid to avoid or deflect suspicion from Hegemony customs officials; it seems unlikely to work, not least because someone has prominently etched 'CHIKAMOSTOCK IZ 4 LOOZERS -AXL' into the hull with a lascutter. Thematically, however, 'unlikely to work' also seems to be an apt description of the vessel itself.

Tough, fast, and heavily armed, salvaged Camel-class frigates are a favorite among up-and-coming pirate captains whenever they turn up on the black market. This particular example sports - along with a number of other questionable modifications - an aggressive paintjob, custom shielded cargo holds, shag carpeting in the officer's quarters, and a pair of gigantic fuzzy dice suspended from the main nav console.

This ship is one of the original vessels brought with the Qamar Insurgency in their long exile from Kadur, heavily modified over the cycles to fit their fleet doctrine of aggressive hit-and-run tactics.
A product of the Stormhawk Republic, this ship has been engineered with highly modular parts and universal weapon mounts to increase its tactical flexibility.
This ship has been overhauled for fleet use by the Rimward Venture Trading Company.

This ship has undergone cutting-edged alterations by the Research Mandate. Utilising advanced (and some might say, A.I. influenced) engineering, this vessel is able to produce localised regions of phased space in their hulls, mitigating some incoming damage. It has also been fitted with auxiliary fuel tanks and built-in surveying equipment, and had its ship system and standard weapon mountings thoroughly modernized.

At first glance this modified Colossus freighter sporting Hegemony livery appears to be a militarized auxiliary, or perhaps even a surviving logistics vessel from the historic Fourteenth Battlegroup. Upon closer inspection however the ships disreputable provenance is clear: The stripes are haphazard, the paint faded, the exterior hull plating crudely welded in place - at least where it hasn't been cut away to provide room for jury-rigged weapon mounts - and to top it all off, somebody has painted 'NOT PIRATES' on one side of the hull and 'TECHNICALLY WE'RE PRIVATEERS' on the other in gigantic, clumsy block capitals.

A member of the elite Iron Armada of Kazeron, this ship has undergone a series of basic - but expertly performed - upgrades designed to harden it against hostile fire and improve its longevity on the battlefield, as well as slightly expand the breadth of ordnance available to it through the conversion of many of its weapon emplacements to accept energy weapons.

Beneath the bright coat of Red Guards livery, this ship has been stripped down and rebuilt for maximum durability at minimal cost. Elaborate sensor arrays and failure-prone high-tech communication consoles have been pared away, leaving only those systems absolutely necessary to the vessel's function as a mercilessly efficient weapon of war.
A product of the Stormhawk Republic, this ship has been engineered with highly modular parts and universal weapon mounts to increase its tactical flexibility.

This ship was manufactured from the original Expansion Era cruiser MPCs seized by the Kadur Theocracy when they stormed the Domain Colonial Star Fortress in orbit over their homeworld at the time of the collapse. Over the past two hundred cycles, numerous modifications have been made to the spec to better suit Kadur fleet doctrine.
A product of the Stormhawk Republic, this ship has been engineered with highly modular parts and universal weapon mounts to increase its tactical flexibility.

Personal flagship of one of the esteemed Knights of Westernesse, this ship has been painstakingly upgraded with a series of exquisitely handcrafted components and systems tweaks by the expert shiptechs of Filkenhild designed to increase its deadliness in combat, as well as slightly reconfigure its weapon groups for better tactical versatility.

Quick and heavily armed, the aggressive Falchion-class destroyer is a prized possession of any pirate warlord with the fortune to count one among their fleet. This particular example sports an aggressive paintjob, shielded cargo holds, and patchwork engines pushed well beyond their normal safe operating envelopes - albeit at the cost of the rear point defense mounts and some systems control overhead.

This ship was manufactured from the original Expansion Era cruiser MPCs seized by the Kadur Theocracy when they stormed the Domain Colonial Star Fortress in orbit over their homeworld at the time of the collapse. Over the past two hundred cycles, numerous modifications have been made to the spec to better suit Kadur fleet doctrine.
A product of the Stormhawk Republic, this ship has been engineered with highly modular parts and universal weapon mounts to increase its tactical flexibility.

This Galleon is worn and battlescarred, but beneath the deep gouges on its armor belts and the plasma burns on its hull it bears the personal colors of a dread pirate lord. Extensively refit for battle, this pirate dreadnought carries enough firepower to reduce an orbital station singlehandedly - and has cargo holds enough to carry away the spoils of such a raid on its own. Truly a fearsome vessel, the Flying Dutchman stands as a monument to the endless ingenuity of mankind when it comes to committing violence against one another.
This ship has been overhauled for fleet use by the Rimward Venture Trading Company, with a focus on bulk efficiency and little regard for optional features such as 'crew comfort'.

This ship bears tell-tale marks of pirate tampering; if the crude up-armoring didn't give it away, the poorly-resoldered flux distribution network certainly would. The high-tech (and high-maintanance) temporal shell system has been stripped out and replaced by a brute-force imitation that grossly overcharges the vessel's weapon mounts. As with "transfer command", some skill effects - such as those increasing ammo capacity, or combat readiness - do not apply to the other ship.

Also enables rapid switching between the linked ships without using a shuttle pod. The transfer is instant if the combined deployment points of the ships are %s or less. The destination ship must not be under the command of an officer or an AI core.

The complexity of the modifications increases the ship's deployment points and supply cost to recover from deployment by %s.
hull_mods.short: Specialized Neural Interface for automated ships.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Transfers from the ship are always instant, regardless of the deployment point total.

hull_mods.name: Shield Conversion - Front
hull_mods.desc: Locks the ship's omni-directional shield emitter to a front-facing position and extends its arc by %s. As with all frontal emitters, the shield will also deploy twice as quickly.
hull_mods.short: Converts omni shield to front, extends arc.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Reduces the amount of damage taken by shields by %s.

hull_mods.name: Shield Conversion - Omni
hull_mods.desc: Converts frontal shields to omni-directional. Reduces the shield's arc by %s.
hull_mods.short: Converts front shield to omni, reduces arc.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Negates the shield arc penalty.

hull_mods.name: Operations Center
hull_mods.desc: Increases the command point recovery rate by %s when installed on the flagship.
hull_mods.short: Increases command point recovery rate when on flagship.

hull_mods.name: Phase Anchor
hull_mods.desc:
Reduces the phase cloak's activation cost to %s. Increases the soft flux dissipation and weapon recharge rate by %s while phased.

When suffering critical damage that would otherwise destroy or disable the ship, able to initiate an emergency dive deep into p-space. The ship counts as retreated and will emerge into normal space when combat is over, suffering an additional penalty to combat readiness equal to %s its deployment cost. The ship must have enough combat readiness to cover this cost to initiate the dive.

Due to the immense distortions in p-space caused by such a maneuver, only one ship per battle - regardless of which side it's on - is able to perform it.
hull_mods.short: Increases flux dissipation and weapon recharge while phased, emergency dive maneuver.

hull_mods.name: Recovery Shuttles
hull_mods.desc: Reduces the casualties suffered by fighter pilots by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces fighter pilot casualties.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases the fighter pilot casualty reduction to %s.

hull_mods.name: Reinforced Bulkheads
hull_mods.desc: Increases the ship's hull integrity by %s. If disabled, the ship will not break apart and is almost always recoverable after the battle.
hull_mods.short: Increases hull integrity; ship almost always recoverable if lost.

hull_mods.name: Resistant Flux Conduits
hull_mods.desc: Decreases the amount of EMP damage taken from weapons such as Ion Cannons by %s. Also increases the ship's flux dissipation rate while venting by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces EMP damage taken, improves venting speed.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases the flux dissipation rate while venting by a further %s.

hull_mods.name: Safety Overrides
hull_mods.tags: special, engines, offensive, merc, no_build_in, standard
hull_mods.desc:
Disabling safety protocols increases the ship's top speed in combat by %s/%s/%s (depending on ship size, with a corresponding increase in acceleration) and allows the zero-flux engine boost to take effect regardless of flux level. The flux dissipation rate, including that of additional vents, is increased by a factor of %s.

Reduces the peak performance time by a factor of %s, prevents the use of active venting, and drastically reduces weapon ranges past %s units.

Can not be installed on civilian or capital ships.
hull_mods.short: Drastic improvement in performance, much lower peak time.

hull_mods.name: Stabilized Shields
hull_mods.desc: Reduces the amount of soft flux raised shields generate per second by %s. Does not affect the hard flux generated as a result of shields taking damage.
hull_mods.short: Reduces flux upkeep for shields.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Converts %s of the hard flux damage taken by shields to soft flux.

hull_mods.name: Unstable Injector
hull_mods.desc:
Increases the ship's top speed in combat by %s/%s/%s/%s su/second, depending on hull size.

Interferes with weapons targeting and other vulnerable systems, reducing non-missile weapon range by %s and increasing the fighter replacement time by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases speed, reduces weapon range.

hull_mods.name: Additional Berthing
hull_mods.desc:
Increases maximum crew capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size, or by %s, whichever is higher.

For civilian-grade hulls, also increases maintenance supply use by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases crew capacity.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Doubles the crew capacity increase and, for civilian hulls, negates the maintenance cost increase.

hull_mods.name: Augmented Drive Field
hull_mods.desc: Increases maximum burn level by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases maximum burn level.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases maximum burn level by a further %s.

hull_mods.name: Auxiliary Fuel Tanks
hull_mods.desc:
Increases maximum fuel capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size, or by %s, whichever is higher.

For civilian-grade hulls, also increases maintenance supply use by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases fuel capacity.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Doubles the fuel capacity increase and, for civilian hulls, negates the maintenance cost increase.

hull_mods.name: Efficiency Overhaul
hull_mods.desc:
Reduces supply use for maintenance, fuel use, and minimum crew required by %s.

Increases the combat readiness recovery and repair rates by %s. The per-day supply consumption for CR recovery is increased to account for the increased recovery rate, but the total supply cost remains the same.
hull_mods.short: Reduces ongoing costs and enables more deployments.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Reduces maintenance cost, fuel use, and minimum crew requirement by a further %s.

hull_mods.name: Expanded Cargo Holds
hull_mods.desc:
Increases maximum cargo capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size, or by %s, whichever is higher.

For civilian-grade hulls, also increases maintenance supply use by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases cargo capacity.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Doubles the cargo capacity increase and, for civilian hulls, negates the maintenance cost increase.

hull_mods.name: High Resolution Sensors
hull_mods.desc: <Tooltip created in script>
hull_mods.short: Increases fleet's sensor range.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases the ship's in-combat vision range by %s/%s/%s/%s, based on hull size.

hull_mods.name: Insulated Engine Assembly
hull_mods.desc:
Increases the durability of the ship's engines by %s, and the ship's hull integrity by %s.

The ship's sensor profile is also reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Makes engines harder to disable, lowers sensor profile.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases engine durability by a further %s, and Increases the sensor profile reduction to %s.

hull_mods.name: Militarized Subsystems
hull_mods.desc:
Removes the penalties from a civilian-grade hull, and increases maximum burn level by %s.

Increases minimum crew required by %s.
hull_mods.short: Removes sensor penalties, increases maximum burn level, increases crew required.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Negates the increased crew requirements.

hull_mods.name: Solar Shielding
hull_mods.desc:
Originally developed by Diktat engineers after spending cycles dealing with the unique conditions of the inner Askonia system. Decreases the effect operating in a solar corona has on combat readiness by %s; also has the same effect against storms in deep hyperspace.

In combat, reduces energy damage taken by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces effect of being in corona and energy damage taken.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases the protection from solar coronae and similar hazards to %s.

hull_mods.name: Surveying Equipment
hull_mods.desc: Reduces the heavy machinery and supplies required to perform surveys by %s/%s/%s/%s depending on hull size, down to a minimum of %s for each.
hull_mods.short: Reduces resource requirements for surveying.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases the survey cost reduction by %s.

hull_mods.name: Terminator Core
hull_mods.desc: Gives all point-defense weapons the ability to identify - and ignore - decoy flares. In addition, all weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness, all damage to missiles and fighters is increased by %s, and beam weapon range is increased by %s units.

hull_mods.name: Shared Flux Sink
hull_mods.desc: Handles %s of the flux dissipation of all attached modules. If modules are lost during battle, the extra flux dissipation is redistributed among the remaining modules. Up to %s of this extra dissipation applies to hard flux.
hull_mods.short: Flux/hard flux dissipation bonus as modules are lost.

hull_mods.name: Stealth Minefield
hull_mods.desc: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.
hull_mods.short: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.

hull_mods.name: Stealth Minefield - Low Tech
hull_mods.desc: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.
hull_mods.short: Mines attack enemy ships during battle.

hull_mods.name: B-Deck
hull_mods.desc:
Once per combat, when the fighter replacement rate reaches %s, the fighter launch bays are switched over to operate from a "B-Deck".

Standby fighters are launched to rapidly bring the wings back up to full strength, and the fighter replacement rate is set to %s.
hull_mods.short: Launches fresh wing once per combat and replenishes the replacement rate.

hull_mods.name: Fighter Chassis Storage
hull_mods.desc: Fighter replacement rate does not go down when fighters are lost.
hull_mods.short: Fighter replacement rate does not go down.

hull_mods.name: Shield Always On
hull_mods.short: Forces shield to stay on. Hidden, doesn't need description or icon.

hull_mods.name: Missile Autoforge
hull_mods.desc: An autoforge inside the ship periodically fully reloads the magazines of all missile weapons.
hull_mods.short: Periodically reloads all missile weapons.

hull_mods.name: Shielded Cargo Holds
hull_mods.desc: Commonly found on ships that can't always rely on shields to protect their cargo from cosmic radiation. Only a few tweaks are needed to have the shielding confound long-range cargo scans, reducing the probability of contraband being detected.
hull_mods.short: Improves chance to avoid detection of contraband.

hull_mods.name: Salvage Gantry
hull_mods.desc: Increases the resources gained from salvaging abandoned stations, derelicts, floating hulks, and other such by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size. Only affects the recovery of common resources such as fuel and supplies, and not rare items like blueprints. In addition, %s of the bonus applies to post-battle salvage.
hull_mods.short: Increases resources gained from salvage.

hull_mods.name: Phase Field
hull_mods.desc: The ship is able to run a low-grade phase field for extended periods of time, reducing its effective sensor profile by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces fleetwide sensor profile.

hull_mods.name: Flux Shunt
hull_mods.desc: Allows the ship to dissipate hard flux at %s of the normal rate while shields are on.
hull_mods.short: Allows dissipation of hard flux while shields are up.

hull_mods.name: Civilian-grade Hull
hull_mods.desc: Increases sensor profile by %s. Reduces sensor strength by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases sensor profile, reduces sensor strength.

hull_mods.name: High Maintenance
hull_mods.desc: Increases the monthly maintenance supply cost by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases maintenance cost.

hull_mods.name: Energy Bolt Coherer
hull_mods.desc: <tooltip created in the script>
hull_mods.short: Increases base range of non-beam energy weapons.

hull_mods.name: Design Compromises
hull_mods.desc:
The ship's performance suffers from competing design priorities, with multiple bleeding-edge projects integrated too late in the design cycle.

The ship's flux dissipation and capacity, even the nominal base values, are reduced by %s.

The range of ballistic weapons is reduced by %s, the rate of fire of missile weapons is reduced by %s, and the flux generation of energy weapons is increased by %s.

On the plus side, extra nanoforge capacity can be brought online more easily, allowing the installation of a %s despite the ship already having a fighter bay, increasing the number of operational fighter bays to %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces missile and ballistic weapon range, and flux dissipation / capacity.

hull_mods.name: Monofilament Tow Cable
hull_mods.desc:
Improves the maximum burn level of the slowest ship in the fleet by 1. Multiple tugs can not be used to speed up the same ship by more than 1.

Can not be used in combat.
hull_mods.short: Increases burn level of another ship.

hull_mods.name: Drive Field Stabilizer
hull_mods.desc:
Stabilizes the fleet's drive bubble, increasing the maximum burn of the fleet by %s. The effect of multiple stabilizers is cumulative.

Increases the ship's sensor profile by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces fleetwide fuel use.

hull_mods.name: Ground Support Package
hull_mods.desc: Close support weapons and counter-measures for ground defenses. Increases the effective strength of planetary raids by %s, up to the total number of marines in the fleet.
hull_mods.short: Improves effectiveness of raids.

hull_mods.name: Advanced Ground Support
hull_mods.desc: Close support weapons and counter-measures for ground defenses. Increases the effective strength of planetary raids by %s, up to the total number of marines in the fleet.
hull_mods.short: Improves effectiveness of raids.

hull_mods.name: Delicate Machinery
hull_mods.desc:
The ship systems require excessive maintenance and do not stand up well under the rigours of prolonged engagements.

Increases the rate of in-combat CR decay after peak performance time runs out by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases CR decay rate after peak time runs out.

hull_mods.name: Heavy Ballistics Integration
hull_mods.desc: Reduces the ordnance point cost of large ballistic weapons by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces ordnance point cost of large ballistic weapons.

hull_mods.name: Vast Hangar
hull_mods.desc:
The ship has a huge hangar and a commensurate small fleet of support craft.

The number of fighter bays added by Converted Hangar is increased by %s, and its performance matches that of a dedicated fighter bay - all of the penalties and modifiers, including those to the ship's deployment cost, are negated.
hull_mods.short: Increases the effect of Converted Hangar and removes its penalties.

hull_mods.name: Rugged Construction
hull_mods.desc:
Reduces most negative effects of d-mods by %s. If disabled or destroyed in combat, the ship has a %s chance to avoid new d-mods, and is almost always recoverable after the battle.

In addition, the supply cost to recover from deployment - and to effect repairs if the ship is disabled - is reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces impact of d-mods; ship almost always recoverable if lost.

hull_mods.name: Automated Ship
hull_mods.desc: This ship is fully automated, and does not require - and can not take on - any human crew.
hull_mods.short: Does not require and can not support crew.

hull_mods.name: Advanced Targeting Core
hull_mods.desc:
Extends the range of ballistic and energy weapons by %s. The range of point-defense weapons is only extended by %s.

Precludes the installation of a Dedicated Targeting Core or an Integrated Targeting Unit.
hull_mods.short: Greatly extends non-missile weapon range.

hull_mods.name: Targeting Supercomputer
hull_mods.desc:
Extends the range of ballistic and energy weapons by %s. The range of point-defense weapons is only extended by %s.

Also increases target-leading accuracy and greatly increases in-combat sensor range.
hull_mods.short: Greatly extends non-missile weapon range.

hull_mods.name: Experimental Phase Coils
hull_mods.desc: Reduces phase cloak cooldown by %s.
hull_mods.short: Greatly reduces phase cloak cooldown.

hull_mods.name: High Volition Attractor
hull_mods.desc: An experimental modification allowing high-frequency motes to be warped in by the rift core on board the ship.
hull_mods.short: Launches more powerful high-frequency motes.

hull_mods.name: Ablative Armor
hull_mods.desc:
An ancient design intended to stop micro-meteorites through sheer volume of material in place, before the advent of "spaced" armor.

Reduces the effective armor strength for the damage reduction calculation to %s of its actual value. However, ships of this design tend to carry extremely heavy armor.
hull_mods.short: Reduces damage reduction by armor.

hull_mods.name: Distributed Fire Control
hull_mods.desc: Much of the damage that takes weapons offline is to external control runs and power conduits. This ship's weapons are engineered to operate more independently, reducing their exposure to damage by %s and reducing the EMP damage taken by the ship overall by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases weapon durability and reduces EMP damage taken.

hull_mods.name: Converted Cargo Bay
hull_mods.desc: This ship's cargo hold has been converted to house a pair of fighter bays. The improvised manufactory that produces fighter chassis is unreliable, and most components have minor defects. Fighter speed reduced by %s, and damage taken increased by %s.
hull_mods.short: Pair of improvised fighter bays.

hull_mods.name: Special Modifications
hull_mods.desc:
During an inspection of an early prototype, the Supreme Executor was heard to comment unfavorably on exposed conduits running along the passageways, and the danger these must pose to the brave and loyal crew under combat conditions. 

The new chief designer, a loyal officer appointed by the Supreme Executor himself, instructed the forge-programmers to make accommodations for the installation of special blast-proof insulated paneling produced by Sindria itself.

If the passages are a bit narrower, conduits prone to overheating, and flush-set panels somewhat unwieldy to access, the official readiness reports include no criticism of the changes. Everyone agrees in both public and - as the Internal Security Ministry can attest - in private, that the stark grandeur of the Lion's Guard fleet is breathtaking.

Crew casualties in combat are increased by %s. The base flux dissipation rate is reduced by %s, and the repair rate for disabled weapons and engines is reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces the ship's performance.

hull_mods.name: Vast Bulk
hull_mods.desc: The main body of this structure is vast and is, for practical purposes, capable of absorbing any amount of damage from conventional weapons without being destroyed.

hull_mods.name: Axial Rotation
hull_mods.desc: This structure constantly rotates around its axis.

hull_mods.name: Anchor Rotation
hull_mods.desc: This structure rotates around its anchor attachment point. For station modules only.

hull_mods.name: Reduced Explosion
hull_mods.desc: Reduced explosion radius and damage.

hull_mods.name: Always Detaches
hull_mods.desc: Always detaches from parent structure when destroyed.

hull_mods.name: Never Detaches
hull_mods.desc: Never detaches from parent structure when destroyed.

hull_mods.name: No Weapon Flux
hull_mods.desc: Weapon fire costs no flux. Used on fighters for fine-grained control of effective shield hitpoints.

hull_mods.name: Do Not Fire Through
hull_mods.desc: Weapons on other modules of a station will avoid firing through this module, even though the shots would go over it and not hit.

hull_mods.name: Shard Spawner
hull_mods.desc: Spawns shard ships when ship is disabled/destroyed.

hull_mods.name: Do Not Back Off
hull_mods.desc: Sets DO_NOT_BACK_OFF AIFlag

hull_mods.name: Threat Hull
hull_mods.desc: Hidden hullmod for managing the special properties of Threat ships. Description created in script.

hull_mods.name: Fragment Swarm
hull_mods.desc:
A swarm of Threat fragments roils around the ship, providing a regenerating supply of fragments for fragment-based weapons.

The base number of fragments is %s/%s/%s/%s, and replacement fragments are launched %s/%s/%s/%s times a second, depending on hull size.

This hullmod is required for fragment weapons to function, if the hullmod is not present or there are not enough fragments in the swarm, fragment weapons will be disabled.
hull_mods.short: A swarm of Threat fragments roils around the ship.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Reduces maximum combat readiness by %s and increases the maintenance cost by %s.

hull_mods.name: Secondary Fabricator
hull_mods.desc: Increases the rate at which replacement fragments are launched by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases the fragment replacement rate.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases the fragment replacement rate by a further %s.

hull_mods.name: Fragment Coordinator
hull_mods.desc: Increases the maximum number of fragments in the ship's fragment swarm by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases the size of the fragment swarm around the ship.
hull_mods.sModDesc: Increases the size of the fragment swarm by a further %s.

hull_mods.name: Dweller Hullmod
hull_mods.desc: Adds Shrouded Dweller visuals and any custom mechanics. Not visible to the player.

hull_mods.name: Shrouded Mantle
hull_mods.desc:
The ship will attempt to recoil (hopefully) away from danger when taking substantial hull damage.

Crew casualties in combat are increased by %s.
hull_mods.short: The ship recoils away from damage.
hull_mods.sModDesc: The ship benefits from %s of the healing provided by Hungering Rift.

hull_mods.name: Shrouded Thunderhead
hull_mods.desc: <created by script>
hull_mods.short: The ship fires Rift Lightning bolts at recent targets of its weapons.

hull_mods.name: Shrouded Lens
hull_mods.desc: <created by script>
hull_mods.short: The Lens automatically focuses on nearby targets, dealing damage in an area.

hull_mods.name: Fourteenth Battlegroup
hull_mods.desc: This ship is a survivor of the original 14th Domain Battlegroup which founded the Hegemony. It is a prime specimen of the Domain Navy's "decisive battle" doctrine, particularly exhibited by a series of radical structural modifications (performed with pre-Collapse industrial methods) which allow the mounting of heavier armor plating by a flat increase of %s standard units, with only a %s reduction in speed and maneuverability. Exceptionally well-tuned energy systems increase flux throughput and capacity by %s over standard examples of this hull.

hull_mods.name: Militarized Hegemony Auxiliary
hull_mods.desc: This ship is - or was - on the Hegemony auxiliary list. Uparmour kits applied at Hegemony Naval yards resulting in no loss of performance for a %s/%s/%s/%s increase in armor strength, depending on hull size. Core power systems have been upgraded to military standards resulting in a %s improvement in overall handling, %s increase in flux capacity, a %s increase in flux dissipation, and an increase of maximum burn level by %s.

hull_mods.name: Compromised Armor
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's armor has taken major and irreparable damage at some point in the past, or suffered from major errors in the manufacturing process. Armor rating reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Compromised Hull
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's hull has taken major and irreparable damage at some point in the past, or suffered from major errors in the manufacturing process. Hull integrity reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Degraded Engines
hull_mods.desc:
Whether due to battle damage, manufacturing defects, or cycles of poor maintenance, this ship's engines are suffering from permanently degraded combat performance. 

Top speed and maneuverability in combat reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Degraded Drive Field
hull_mods.desc:
Whether due to battle damage, manufacturing defects, or cycles of poor maintenance, this ship's drive field is suffering from permanently degraded performance. 

Maximum burn level decreased by %s. Sensor profile increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Faulty Power Grid
hull_mods.desc:
Whether due to battle damage, manufacturing defects, or cycles of poor maintenance, this ship's power grid will never be capable of achieving peak performance.

Flux capacity reduced by %s. Flux dissipation rate reduced by %s. Sensor profile increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Phase Coil Instability
hull_mods.desc:
The phase coils on this ship are impossible to calibrate properly due to subtle flaws. Reduces the phase-time bonus by %s, reduces the peak performance time by %s, and increases the rate at which combat readiness degrades by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Structural Damage
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's hull has likely taken extreme damage in the past, possibly to the point of breaking apart. Armor rating reduced by %s, hull integrity reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Glitched Sensor Array
hull_mods.desc:
The ship's sensor array is damaged past any repair short of a complete hull overhaul. Weapon range in combat reduced by %s. Sensor strength reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Malfunctioning Comms
hull_mods.desc:
The comm system has suffered serious damage, making punching through battlefield jamming even more of a challenge. Fighter engagement range reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Defective Manufactory
hull_mods.desc:
The manufactory that produces fighter chassis is unreliable, and most components have minor defects. Fighter speed reduced by %s, and damage taken increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Damaged Flight Deck
hull_mods.desc:
The flight decks on this ship have taken major damage and seriously interfere with normal operation. Time to launch replacement fighters is increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Unreliable Subsystems
hull_mods.desc:
A widespread loss of redundant components reduces peak operating time by %s, and increases the rate at which combat readiness degrades by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Compromised Storage
hull_mods.desc:
The storage capacity of this ship is significantly degraded. Crew, cargo, and fuel capacity reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.

hull_mods.name: Increased Maintenance
hull_mods.desc:
Increases the monthly maintenance supply cost by %s. Increases minimum crew required by %s. Decreases maximum combat readiness by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases maintenance cost and crew requirements, decreases maximum combat readiness.

hull_mods.name: Erratic Fuel Injector
hull_mods.desc:
Increases fuel use by %s and decreases the zero-flux boost by %s su/second.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases fuel use and decreases the zero-flux boost.

hull_mods.name: Faulty Automated Systems
hull_mods.desc:
Increases minimum crew required by %s and decreases maximum combat readiness by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases minimum crew required, decreases maximum combat readiness.

hull_mods.name: Damaged Weapon Mounts
hull_mods.desc:
Reduces weapon turn rate by %s and increases recoil by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces weapon turn rate and increases recoil.

hull_mods.name: Degraded Life Support
hull_mods.desc:
Decreases maximum crew capacity by %s, and maximum combat readiness by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Decreases maximum crew capacity and combat readiness.

hull_mods.name: Degraded Shields
hull_mods.desc:
Increases the amount of damage taken by shields by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases damage taken by shields.

hull_mods.name: Destroyed Weapon Mounts
hull_mods.desc: Some of the original weapon mounts on this ship have been damaged beyond repair and can no longer be used.

hull_mods.name: Ill-Advised Modifications
hull_mods.desc: This hull's systems have been drastically modified from spec, likely without certified engineering oversight. Its systems appear to work correctly under routine conditions, but have a significant chance of critical malfunction when stressed.

In addition, all weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat radius, and all damage to fighters is increased by %s.

hull_mods.name: Lions Guard LPC
hull_mods.desc:
The Sindrian Diktat’s elite receives the cream of the crop in fighter craft.  Many Lion’s Guard LPCs are modified with post-production flux management upgrades and fighter-grade solar shielding to the finished airframe, resulting in 10% improvements to flux stats and a 20% reduction to energy weapon damage.

While pushing the fighter’s flux core to their limits does provide a small and exploitable edge to the pilots, the solar shielding is the feature most appreciated by Lion’s Guard airmen (and the most coveted by Diktat regulars), as it affords protection to their craft against the dangers of both energy-based PD and the inner askonia system alike.  Studies suggest this is a major reason that Guardsmen pilots survive their tours of duty at a far higher rate than their regular military counterparts, and retire from service with fewer health defects.
hull_mods.short: Improves flux stats by 10%, energy weapon resistance by 20%

hull_mods.name: XIV Battlegroup LPC
hull_mods.desc: The Fourteenth Battlegroup, like many other notable units, received customized LPCs suited to their needs.  In addition to often-revised armament loadouts, Fourteenth Battlegroup strike craft consistently feature reinforced core components increasing armor plating by a flat increase of %s standard units, with only a %s reduction in speed and maneuverability. Exceptionally well-tuned energy systems increase flux throughput and capacity by %s over standard examples of this hull.

hull_mods.desc: This ship has been rebuilt with simple, multiply redundant, and easily replaced modular components with an eye towards durability and ease of maintenance. hull_mods.desc: This ship has been the recipient of an advanced targeting unit clearly transplanted - with great effort - from a capital-class warship. Extends the range of nonmissile weapons by %s. Precludes the installation of a Dedicated Targeting Core or an Integrated Targeting Unit.

hull_mods.desc: This ship has been mercilessly optimized for bulk efficiency and protection from asset depreciation/loss at the expense of all other considerations. Maintenance costs, fuel use, and minimum crew required have all been reduced by %s, and armor has been increased by %s points. However, speed and maneuverability are both reduced by %s.

hull_mods.desc:
This ship has been refit by Ashen Knight enginseers for use in their neverending fight for survival against more fundamentalist Luddic sects. Buttressed and spaced reactive armor panels increase armor rating by %s points and reduce damage taken from incoming missiles over %s by %s, up to a maximum of %s points of damage reduction. In addition, the hull has been studded with microscale close-range EMP emitters which will engage and create disabling arcs to %s every %s.

hull_mods.name: Stormhawk Modular Engineering
hull_mods.desc: This ship has been constructed in accordance with the Stormhawk Republic's advanced modular engineering standards, replacing several of its weapon emplacements with highly-adaptable %s mounts. This design philosophy extends to any nanoforges installed in the hull, where a ready supply of prefabricated fighter chassis and weapons modules enable the strike craft refits to be performed %s faster.

hull_mods.name: Integrated Bulkhead Flicker-Coils
hull_mods.desc:
Miniaturized low-power phase coils integrated into the bulkheads of this advanced combat vessel enable it to momentarily 'flicker' portions of its structure out of existence when fired upon, taking %s less hull and armor damage from all sources. The phase coils run continuously at a low power when not spooled to combat readiness, reducing sensor signature by %s.

As an unintended side effect of the truly stupendous amounts of power being channeled through the hull, the coils will %s if the ship is ever destroyed.

hull_mods.name: Broadside Core
hull_mods.desc: Extends the range of nonmissile weapons by %s. Precludes the installation of a Dedicated Targeting Core or an Integrated Targeting Unit.

hull_mods.name: Iron Armada
hull_mods.desc: A member of the elite Iron Armada of Kazeron, this ship has undergone a series of basic - but expertly performed - upgrades designed to harden it against hostile fire and improve its longevity on the battlefield. Increases armor by %s points, weapon and engine health by %s points, and reduces overload time by %s.

hull_mods.name: Order of Westernesse
hull_mods.desc: Personal flagship of one of the esteemed Knights of Westernesse, this ship has been painstakingly upgraded with a series of exquisitely handcrafted components and systems tweaks by the expert shiptechs of Filkenhild designed to increase its deadliness in combat. Increases ballistic weapon rate of fire by %s, beam damage by %s, and maneuverability by %s.

hull_mods.name: Broad-Spectrum AI Inhibitor
hull_mods.desc:
Installs complex exotic radiative devices throughout the ship, jamming the specific wavelengths required for higher-level AI functionality with a tide of white noise and promising some protection against any hostile artificial entity present aboard the vessel. Interferes with the more advanced of a ship's automated systems, reducing maximum combat readiness by %s and increasing minimum crew required by %s.

Although generally considered the exclusive provenance of paranoid luddics, some scavenger captains swear by such devices - crediting them with saving their lives from psychotic food processing droids, rampant nanomachine infestations, or even rogue alpha-plus level AI cores loose in their ships' cogitator banks.
hull_mods.short: Inhibits all AI activity onboard the ship, requiring extra crew and reducing combat readiness.

hull_mods.name: Ghost Ship
hull_mods.desc:
Discovered drifting and wrecked in a remote system, this ship was lost under uncertain circumstances. Scattered reports of crew going missing have so far remained unconfirmed. A sense of dread shrouds the vessel and weighs heavily on the crew, who demand a force of marine guards be continually stationed aboard, 'just in case' - in case of what, nobody is entirely sure. Reduces maximum combat readiness by up to %s if at least %s marines are not stationed on board.

hull_mods.desc:
Discovered drifting and wrecked in a remote system, this ship's internal cogitators are host to a rogue, malevolent Alpha plus-class AI which has so far proved extremely resistant - sometimes lethally - to any attempts to remove it. Theories that this entity is somehow related to the droneships deployed by the Tri-Tachyon Corporation during the First AI War have so far remained unconfirmed. Though any potential danger has been brought - mostly - under control by means of completely removing any unnecessary automated systems, the crew still demands a force of marine guards be continually stationed aboard 'just in case'. Anomalous happenings - noises and sounds, some consistent with those reported by crew who have spent extended periods of time aboard phase ships or near makeshift hyperwave communication relays, others less explicable - are common aboard ship, especially during hyperspace travel. Crew mysteriously disappear at a rate of approximately %s while in hyperspace, and the vessel has a chance to spontaneously phase out when taking damage in non-simulated combat. A sense of dread weighs heavily on the ship's inhabitants, who demand a force of marine guards be continually stationed aboard, just in case - in case of what, nobody is entirely sure. hull_mods.desc:
Discovered drifting and wrecked in a remote system, this ship is host to an infestation of hostile xenolife which has so far proven extremely resistant - lethally so - to any attempts to remove it from the hull. Reports of activity are currently %s. A complex web of antipersonnel mines and automated defenses have so far kept the creatures from encroaching too far into the inhabited areas of the vessel, but the crew demands a force of marine guards be continually stationed aboard in case of sudden attack. Reduces maximum combat readiness by up to %s if at least %s marines are not stationed on board.

hull_mods.name: Plague Ship
hull_mods.desc:
Discovered drifting and wrecked in a remote system, this ship is host to an incredibly lethal and fast-incubating engineered plague which has so far proven extremely resistant to decontamination and sterilization attempts. The bioweapon is incredibly virulent, and accidental contaminations as a result of containment breach are frequent and unavoidable. The stench of death shrouds the vessel and weighs heavily on the crew, who demand a force of marine guards and medics be continually stationed aboard, 'just in case' - though the mortality rate among those affected is currently 100%%, and crew will be lost at a rate of approximately %s regardless. Reduces maximum combat readiness by up to %s if at least %s marines are not stationed on board. 

You currently have %s marines compared to a total of %s required to properly secure all ships in your fleet requiring marine guards, resulting in a maximum combat readiness penalty of %s.

hull_mods.name: Nanite Host
hull_mods.desc:
Discovered drifting and wrecked in a remote system, this ship is host to a swarm of strange nanoscale machines of unknown origin, which has so far proven extremely resistant - often fatally - to attempts to remove it from the vessel. Supplies - and crewmembers - are lost at a rate of approximately %s in combating the infestation and repairing incidental damage, and the ship has a chance to spontaneously disgorge swarms of nanites to defend itself when damaged in non-simulated combat. The crew demands a force of marine guards be continually stationed aboard, 'just in case' - though the mass of nanites aboard the ship has been shown to be entirely immune to standard antipersonnel weaponry. Reduces maximum combat readiness by up to %s if at least %s marines are not stationed on board. 

You currently have %s marines compared to a total of %s required to properly secure all ships in your fleet requiring marine guards, resulting in a maximum combat readiness penalty of %s.

hull_mods.name: Semi-Stable Dimensional Anomalies
hull_mods.desc: This hull bears the scars of decades of combat and trans-dimensional flight, its bulkheads and armor plates tangibly weathered by plasma fire and hyperspace storms. The ship's cogitators and inbuilt semi-intelligent automation cores have developed several 'tics' over the cycles, and at times it seems almost alive - the dull thumping of ballast autonomously being shifted or cargo spaces being rearranged echoing through its corridors like the labored beating of some vast and incomprehensible heart. Anomalous happenings - noises and sounds, some consistent with those reported by crew who have spent extended periods of time aboard phase ships or near makeshift hyperwave communication relays, others less explicable - are common aboard the ship, especially during hyperspace travel. Crew disappear at a rate of approximately %s while in hyperspace, claimed by whatever dark purpose the hull now works toward, and the vessel has a chance to spontaneously phase out when taking damage in non-simulated combat.

hull_mods.name: Misshapen Turret Gyros
hull_mods.desc:
Whether due to battle damage or errors in the manufacturing process, weapons mounted on this ship suffer from slower than normal traverse speed, relative vulnerability to damage and increased chances of randomly malfunctioning. Weapon turn speed reduced by %s, weapon health reduced by %s and random malfunction chance increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces weapon turn rates and durability and increases their malfunction chance.

hull_mods.name: Inoperative Automated Systems
hull_mods.desc:
Due to flaws introduced during manufacturing or possibly battle damage, automated systems aboard the ship that would normally assist the crew are almost entirely inoperable. Maximum combat readiness reduced by %s, and minimum crew required increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases minimum crew required and reduces maximum CR.

hull_mods.name: Performance Irregularities
hull_mods.desc:
This ship suffers from widespread malfunctions and minor glitches, all of which combine to produce a marked negative effect on its overall combat performance. Maximum combat readiness reduced by %s, has a %s chance of suffering weapon malfunctions and a %s chance of suffering engine malfunctions during battle.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces maximum CR and has a small chance of causing malfunctions.

hull_mods.name: Malformed Fighter Weapons
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's fighter manufactory is damaged or glitched in a particular manner that causes no ill effect to the general performance of chassis it produces, but dramatically reduces the effectiveness of their weapons. Fighter ballistic/energy/missile damage reduced by %s/%s/%s, Fighter accuracy reduced by %s and Fighter recoil increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases recoil and reduces damage dealt by as well as accuracy of launched fighters and bombers.

hull_mods.name: Buckled Environmental Shielding
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's environmental and radiation shielding has taken major and irreparable damage at some point in the past, or suffered from major errors in the manufacturing process. Damage taken from EMP weapons increased by %s, damage taken from environmental or terrain effects increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases damage taken from environmental hazards, hostile terrain, and EMP weapons.

hull_mods.name: Noncompliant Gunnery Core
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's integrated gunnery control cogitators are severely out of sync, and have developed several "tics" unsettlingly akin to the effects of post-traumatic stress disorder in human crew members. Autofire accuracy reduced by %s, projectile speed reduced by %s, and weapon recoil increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces autofire accuracy and projectile speed, and increases weapon recoil.

hull_mods.name: Impaired Life Support Systems
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's basic life support systems are barely functional as a result of terrible damage to the ship, critical errors in its manufacturing, or gross mismanagement over the cycles. Whatever the reason, this hull is capable of supporting only a severely limited number of semipermanent crew berthings, and those only in significant discomfort. Maximum combat readiness reduced by %s, and crew capacity reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces maximum CR and crew capacity.

hull_mods.name: Distorted Optics
hull_mods.desc:
This ship suffers from degraded and flawed optics of the type normally used to project combat beams, rendering any weapons of that type installed on this hull exceptionally short-ranged and inaccurate. Beam range reduced by %s, and accuracy reduced by up to %s degrees of arc.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces beam weapon range and accuracy.

hull_mods.name: Flawed Missile Racks
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's missile mounts are misshapen and deformed, either by battle damage or due to errors in the manufacturing process. Missile weapon ammunition reduced by %s, fire rate increased by %s and guidance reduced by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces missile weapon maximum ammunition and guidance but increases fire rate.

hull_mods.name: Irregular Feed Mechanisms
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's ballistic mounts are notably warped, either through damage to the hull or errors in its manufacturing, and interfere with the proper feeding of ammunition to any weapons mounted in them. Ballistic weapons suffer %s lower rate of fire, and %s higher flux generation while firing.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Reduces ballistic weapon rate of fire and flux efficiency.

hull_mods.name: Malfunctioning Ammo Forge
hull_mods.desc:
This ship's ammunition autoforges suffer from severe damage or degredation, and are incapable of prcoessing the exotic materials typically used in high-performance kinetic, explosive, and energy munitions, randomly generating bad ammunition. Ballistic and missile weapons installed on the hull deal %s damage with %s chance per shot.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: 50% chance to change the type of damage dealt by ballistic and missile weapons to Fragmentation.

hull_mods.name: Destabilized Shield Generator
hull_mods.desc:
The shield generator on this ship is impossible to calibrate properly due to subtle flaws, introduced through damage to the underlying systems and infrastructure, errors during their manufacturing, or cycles of poor maintenance. Shield upkeep cost increased by %s, and damage taken increased by %s.

Supply cost to recover from deployment reduced by %s.
hull_mods.short: Increases shield upkeep cost and reduces efficiency.

hull_mods.name: Ashen Shielding
hull_mods.desc: The Here-Techs of the Ashen Keepers have learned to rely heavily on their superior shield emitters in combat, tuning them for even better performance against the high explosive weaponry common employed by other, less technically-inclined, sects of Ludd's faithful. Reduces high explosive damage taken by shields by %s.

hull_mods.name: Solidarity Forever
hull_mods.desc: Crews sourced from the Persean Democratic Peoples' Revolutionary Council, no matter the sect or sub-order they follow, are united in one cause: To bring birth to a new Sector from the ashes of the old. Their fervor carries through to their work, allowing them to carry out their duties in conditions where most would abandon their posts. Increases base peak performance time by %s seconds.

hull_mods.name: Mandate Optics
hull_mods.desc: The Independent AI War Research Mandate requires that their ships be equipped with specially modified optical systems and integrated gunnery AIs, which extend the range of ballistic and energy weapons by %s/%s/%s/%s percent, depending on hull size. The space required for the complicated assembly requires the removal of some of the ship's plating, reducing armor rating by %s/%s/%s/%s depending on hull size.

hull_mods.name: Rimward Efficiency
hull_mods.desc: Merchants of the Rimward Venture Trading Company are always eager to cut corners and enjoy maximizing space wherever possible. Increases maximum cargo capacity by %s/%s/%s/%s, depending on hull size.

hull_mods.name: Stormhawk Elite Pilots
hull_mods.desc: Pilots of the Stormhawk Republic are extremely skilled interceptors and dogfighters, and carry out extensive training to ensure they keep their edge. Fighters deal an extra %s damage to enemy fighters, bombers, and other strike craft.

hull_mods.name: Collapsed Cargo Holds
hull_mods.desc:
Collapses the ship's cargo holds and welds them together for additional protection. Increases the ship's armor by %s, with no loss of mobility. The amount of effective protection that can be gained in this manner limits bonus armor to %s at most.
